name: doctest
listed_description: Lightweight, feature-rich single-header C++ unit testing framework, inspired by Catch2, aimed at fast compile times so tests fit into everyday builds.
claim_text: Doctest stands out for its compile-time and runtime performance, making it ideal for rapid development cycles.
book_benchmark: No measurement in the book; qualitative comparison against Google Test, Catch2 and Boost.Test only. Repository README claims faster compile and runtime than other feature-rich frameworks, with numbers in its own benchmarks document (not checked by miner).
